corrections.reason: The printed glyph in Col 1 L04 is the 4th-order राብዕ 'ፋ' (አጥፋ, singular imperative matching 'አሉት'), which was misread as 2nd-order ካዕብ 'ፉ'.
Both verbs on Col 1 L26 are clearly printed with 4th-order 'ፋ' (ያጠፋ ፡ ዘንድ ፡ አጥፋ ፡ አሉት), agreeing in singular number with 'አሉት'.
